title: Google Ads
source: spec DTC-03 / X-14 read side. Read-only: the skill downloads reports and reads tables; it never changes the account
never: Change anything in the account: campaigns, budgets, bids, keywords, ads, assets, goals, conversion actions, audiences, settings
Apply or dismiss recommendations; accept terms or invitations
Open Billing, payment methods or Admin > Access and security
Type into a sign-in, password, verification or payment field

parts.goal: Set the account-wide date range to {period} (the picker at the top right; a preset applies at once, no Apply button needed)
parts.check: every downloaded report covers {period_days} days ending yesterday or today

parts.goal: Download the Campaigns table (all campaigns, the period's totals) as .csv
parts.check: a new file arrives that parses as a Google Ads campaign report

parts.goal: Download the Search terms table (Campaigns > Insights and reports > Search terms) as .csv
parts.check: a new file arrives that parses as a Google Ads search terms report

parts.goal: Download the Products table (Campaigns > Products) as .csv; when the account has no product data, say so
parts.check: a new file arrives that parses as a Google Ads products report

parts.goal: Read every row of the conversion actions table (Goals > Conversions > Summary > View all conversion actions)
parts.check: one row per conversion action, each with name, status and optimization (Primary/Secondary)
